description: Minister of Justice Public Administration and Home Affairs - Pradeshiya Sabhas Act.No.15 of 1987 Order - Alpitiya Pradshiya sabha.
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns the re-establishment and electoral composition of the Elpitiya Pradeshiya Sabha, a local government body. It specifies the number of elected and returned members, the commencement date of the term of office, and references the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. This falls under electoral processes and local authority administration, making it an Elections Gazette (Type 7). While it names the Prime Minister, the core content is not about her appointment or her ministerial portfolio responsibilities (which would make it a Hybrid gazette), but rather about the electoral and administrative setup of a local authority.
